import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Topology Filter Real Complex TopologicalSpace Finset
open scoped BigOperators

theorem closed_set_disjoint_perfect_countable (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] [SeparableSpace X]
  (A : Set X) (hA : IsClosed A) :
  ∃ P C : Set X, A = P ∪ C ∧ Disjoint P C ∧ Perfect P ∧ Set.Countable C ∧ P ⊆ A ∧ C ⊆ A := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V, D, hVcount, hDperfect, hdecomp⟩ :=
    exists_countable_union_perfect_of_isClosed (α := X) (C := A) hA
  
  have hDsub : D ⊆ A := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact Or.inr hx
  
  have hVsub : V ⊆ A := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hdecomp]
    exact Or.inl hx
  
  let C : Set X := V \ D
  
  have hnewdecomp : A = D ∪ C := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [hdecomp] at hx
      rcases hx with hxV | hxD
      · by_cases hxD' : x ∈ D
        · exact Or.inl hxD'
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hxV, hxD'⟩
      · exact Or.inl hxD
    · intro hx
      rw [hdecomp]
      rcases hx with hxD | hxC
      · exact Or.inr hxD
      · exact Or.inl hxC.1
  
  have hdisj : Disjoint D C := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_
    intro x hxD hxC
    exact hxC.2 hxD
  
  have hCcount : Set.Countable C := by
    exact hVcount.mono (by
      intro x hx
      exact hx.1)
  
  have hCsub : C ⊆ A := by
    intro x hx
    exact hVsub hx.1
  
  exact ⟨D, C, hnewdecomp, hdisj, hDperfect, hCcount, hDsub, hCsub⟩

    rcases hxAD with hxV | hxD
    · exact hxV
    · exact False.elim (hxC.2 hxD)
